title: 第四章 给钱儿子也是可以谈的第三章 大叔随便玩玩啦
lines: 在一回头却发现人已经不见了，只留下一旁偷笑的小姐姐。
李牧同学已经一溜烟的闪了，一个老外的中文说的这么好，真当小爷是骗大的。
在天桥对面的kfc里，一个看上去四十来岁的中年男人正正坐在靠窗的位置，面前没有放任何食物，只摆着一只玻璃茶杯，茶杯里漂浮着不知道已经泡过几遍的茶叶。
透过巨大的玻璃窗，中年男人看到了从天桥上跑下来的少年，不耐烦的脸上终于露出一丝笑意。
“老爸，我回来了！”少年一阵风似的来到中年男人面前，帅气的面孔上带着阳光般灿烂笑容。
“赢了？”老李盖上杯子，再不来他快被店员的白眼甩死了。
“那当然，你儿子什么时候输过！”
“记得你答应的，你老子可是用家主的地位在你老妈面前担保的，一定要考一个名牌大学，最好是将来能当官的，别欺负我读书少，你老子的拳头可不是吃素的。”老李挥舞了一下他沙包大的拳头，他不懂什么游戏不游戏的，只知道教育孩子也得跟做生意一样，给点甜头才能达成目的。
“放心好了！”李牧刚准备好好表表忠心，就见网吧那个猥琐男冲了过来。
“killer，我们好好谈谈，我真的很有诚意！”朱镇钟焦急的说道，赢了look的天才绝对是拯救ssg的唯一希望，他必须拿下。
老李豁然站了起来，挥舞着拳头，“小子，你找死啊，想拐我儿子，信不信我沙包大的拳头打死你！”
五分钟之后，三人已经坐定了，而且朱镇钟请客点了餐，店员小姐姐的表情柔和了很多。
“这么说，你是韩国大公司的老板了？”老李笑眯眯的说道，一旁的小李没有说话的份儿了，他知道一旦老爸笑眯眯的时候就是他奸商本质开始套路了。
“不是老板，是经理，不过您放心我一样能做主，我们公司网上一查就能查出来，绝对正规，签字费有50万人民币，而且我保证，killer在我们公司的培养下，会成为电竞顶级的明星选手，在韩国电竞跟足球篮球一样，年薪千万都不是问题！”朱镇钟心里暗中送了口气，毕竟是职业经理人，看对方的打扮和表情就知道家庭情况不怎么样，只要有弱点就好谈。
老李淡淡的看了一眼韩国佬，把合同一扣，“这些什么乱七八糟的我看不懂，但我儿子太小，我不会让他出国的。”
朱镇钟咬了咬牙，“60万！”
“一百万，我最讨厌别人跟我讨价还价，搞的跟卖儿子一样，爱干就干，不干滚蛋！”老李一脸的嫌弃，一旁的小李完全成了小透明，老爹，你关心的是问题是价钱吧？
朱镇钟有点头痛，看了看killer，脑海里瞬间出现了他一波飞龙甩死look的超秀场面，人生就在于搏，大老远的来中国不能空手而归啊。
“好，就这么定了，但是按照我们的规矩一签就是五年，这期间……”
老李不耐烦的摆摆手，“明天，这里，一手交钱一手交货！”
老李带着小李走了，留下了一脸兴奋的朱镇钟，钱他可以垫付，这根本不是问题，一想到ssg可以崛起他就充满了能量，而且未来中国市场的成熟，他的这一步绝对是非常英明的一步。
路上，李牧实在忍不住了，“老爸，我是你亲生的吗？”
小李的脑袋吃了个板栗，“笨，你小子是块什么料以为我不知道吗，能天天打游戏还不乐死。”
“万一对方是骗子呢？”小李不甘心的撇撇嘴，去韩国打职业，啧啧，听着就爽啊，吊打职业多好玩啊，不过为了配合老爹还价，他当然不会说，以前老李摆摊卖菜的时候他们就是这么唱双簧的，一般李牧说一句，阿姨，这菜是今天才到的，基本上就卖光了。
老李翻了翻白眼，“你真当外国人人傻钱多吗，你就告诉我想不想去就行！”
李牧嘿嘿一笑，开玩笑啊，这简直峰回路转，柳暗花明啊。
第二天，双方非常顺利的签约，而朱镇钟预付30万，他要先回韩国安排一下，一个月之后带着剩余的部分来接李牧，这也让老李更安心了一点。
然而一个月之后朱镇钟并没有来，又一个月，老李接到了朱镇钟的电话，哔哔一通，大体意思是ssg被收购了，新老板反对这笔交易，按照合同规定是老李这边要退一部分费用的，这不是开玩笑吗，房子都买了，钱是没有的，最终朱镇钟只能捏着鼻子忍了，但李牧在合同期里不允许参加任何正式非正式的游戏赛事……
当年的事儿确实改变了家庭的命运，但对李牧自己却是个不小的阻碍，不过小李同学别的没有，就是天生乐观，这点继承了老李，再说，自己哪儿老了，十足的小鲜肉啊！
望着屏幕右下角的日期，李牧禁不住有点傻乐，还有十二天合同就到期了，到时候他就是查克拉蓄满的火影，见面就qwer……
“李~~~牧~~~~~~打打打，就知道抱着个破电脑，赶快给我滚出来！”一声河东狮子吼唤醒了李牧的多愁善感，几乎是连滚带爬的冲了出去。
“老妈，你儿子心脏不好，别这么大声好不好。”吃饭的时间到了，李牧立刻颠着屁股“滚”了出来。
一旁的老李把保温杯放在一旁忍不住偷笑。
“笑笑笑，你儿子马上就要毕业了，知不知道现在工作多难找，看看这个当爹的，一点本事关系都没，让你去拍拍隔壁老林的马屁，他好歹是个科长，你要脸，要不是沾了我儿子的光，哪儿有自己的房子住！”张春吼道，老李一家从山东来的，06年买房绝对是最英明的决定，只是看着儿子要毕业，张春的操心病又犯了。
“那也是我儿子，再说……”老李小小的反抗了一下。
李牧忍不住噗嗤一笑，老妈最近大概是提前更年期，爷儿俩的日子……很苦。

content_en:
When I turned around, I found that the person was gone, leaving only the little sister who was snickering.
Classmate Li Mu had already escaped in a flash. For a foreigner who speaks Chinese so well, it would be a lie to think that he is a master.
In the KFC across the overpass, a middle-aged man who looked to be in his forties was sitting by the window. There was no food in front of him, only a glass teacup with tea leaves that had been brewed several times floating in the teacup.
Through the huge glass window, the middle-aged man saw the young man running down the overpass, and a smile finally appeared on his impatient face.
"Dad, I'm back!" The young man came to the middle-aged man like a gust of wind, with a smile as bright as the sun on his handsome face.
"You win?" Lao Li covered the cup. If he didn't come back, he would be killed by the clerk's eyes.
"Of course, when has your son ever lost?"
"Remember what you promised. I used my position as the head of the family to guarantee in front of your mother that I must get into a prestigious university, preferably one that can be an official in the future. Don't bully me for not studying well. I'm not a vegetarian with my fists." Lao Li waved his fist as big as a sandbag. He didn't know what games were not games. He only knew that educating children must be like doing business, and he must give some sweetness to achieve his goal.
"Don't worry!" Li Mugang was just about to show his loyalty when he saw the wretched man from the Internet cafe rushing over.
"Killer, let's talk about it, I'm really sincere!" Zhu Zhenzhong said anxiously. The genius who won the look is definitely the only hope to save SSG, he must win.
Lao Li suddenly stood up and waved his fist, "Boy, you are looking for death. You want to abduct my son. Believe it or not, I will beat you to death with my fist as big as a sandbag!"
Five minutes later, the three of them were seated, and Zhu Zhenzhong ordered a meal. The expression of the waitress became much softer.
"So, you are the boss of a big company in South Korea?" Lao Li said with a smile. Xiao Li on the side couldn't speak anymore. He knew that once his father smiled, his businessman nature would start to trick him.
"I'm not the boss, I'm the manager, but don't worry, I can still make the decision. Our company can be found online. It's absolutely legitimate. The signing fee is 500,000 yuan. And I guarantee that Killer will become a top star player in e-sports under the training of our company. In Korean e-sports, like football and basketball, an annual salary of 10 million is not a problem!" Zhu Zhenzhong secretly breathed a sigh of relief. After all, he is a professional manager. He can tell by the other party's dress and expression that his family situation is not good. As long as he has weaknesses, it is easy to talk.
Lao Li glanced at the Korean guy indifferently and clicked the contract, "I can't understand all this nonsense, but my son is too young and I won't let him go abroad."
Zhu Zhenzhong gritted his teeth, "600,000!"
"One million, I hate it the most when people bargain with me. It's like selling my son. Do whatever you want, or get out if you don't!" Old Li looked disgusted, and Xiao Li beside him became completely transparent. Dad, what you care about is the price, right?
Zhu Zhenzhong had a headache. He looked at Killer, and the super show scene of him killing his look with a wave of flying dragons instantly appeared in his mind. Life is all about fighting. You can't come back empty-handed after coming all the way to China.
"Okay, that's it, but according to our rules, one signature is for five years. During this period..."
Lao Li waved his hand impatiently, "Tomorrow, here, pay with one hand and deliver the goods with the other hand!"
Lao Li took Xiao Li away, leaving behind an excited Zhu Zhenzhong. He could advance the money, which was not a problem at all. He was full of energy when he thought about the rise of SSG, and with the maturity of the Chinese market in the future, his step was definitely a very wise one.
On the way, Li Mu couldn't bear it anymore, "Dad, am I your biological child?"
Bang~~~
Xiao Li felt a chestnut in his head, "Stupid, do you think I don't know what kind of guy you are? You can play games every day and you won't be happy to die."
"What if the other party is a liar?" Xiao Li curled his lips unwillingly and went to South Korea to work professionally. Tsk tsk, it feels so good to listen to it. It's so fun to play professionally. But in order to cooperate with his father's counter-offer, of course he wouldn't say that they used to sing like this when Lao Li set up a stall to sell vegetables. Usually Li Mu would just say, "Auntie, this dish just arrived today, and it was basically sold out."
Lao Li rolled his eyes, "Do you really think foreigners are stupid and have too much money? Just tell me if you want to go!"
Li Mu chuckled, "You're just kidding, this is a complete turn of events."
The next day, the two parties signed the contract very smoothly, and Zhu Zhenzhong paid 300,000 in advance. He had to go back to South Korea to make arrangements first, and pick up Li Mu with the remaining part a month later, which made Lao Li feel more at ease.
However, Zhu Zhenzhong did not come one month later. Another month later, Lao Li received a call from Zhu Zhenzhong. It beeped. It basically meant that SSG had been acquired. The new boss objected to the deal. According to the contract, Lao Li had to refund part of the fee. Isn't this a joke? The house was bought and the money was gone. In the end, Zhu Zhenzhong could only hold his nose and bear it, but Li Mu was not allowed to participate in any formal or informal game events during the contract period...
What happened that year did indeed change the fate of the family, but it was a big obstacle to Li Mu himself. However, Xiao Li’s classmate has nothing but a natural optimism. He inherited this from Lao Li. Besides, he has not aged at all, he is a complete young man!
Looking at the date in the lower right corner of the screen, Li Mu couldn't help but feel a little silly. The contract will expire in twelve days. By then, he will be the Hokage with full chakra, and he will qwer when he meets...
"Li~~~Mu~~~~~~ I'm holding a broken computer, just get out of here!" A Hedong lion's roar awakened Li Mu's sentimentality, and he rushed out almost rolling and crawling.
"Mom, your son has a bad heart, please don't be so loud." When it was time to eat, Li Mu immediately bumped his butt and "rolled out".
Lao Li on the side put the thermos cup aside and couldn't help but snicker.
"Xiao Xiaoxiao, your son is about to graduate. Do you know how hard it is to find a job now? Look at this father. He has no skills at all. I asked you to flatter Lao Lin next door. He is a section chief after all. You want face. If you didn't take advantage of my son, you wouldn't have your own house to live in!" Zhang Chun roared. Lao Li's family came from Shandong. Buying a house in 2006 was definitely the wisest decision. But seeing his son graduating, Zhang Chun's worry returned.
"That's my son too. Besides..." Lao Li resisted slightly.
Li Mu couldn't help but chuckle. His mother probably went through early menopause recently, and the life of father and son... was very difficult.

title_en: Chapter 4: You can talk about giving money to your son. Chapter 3: Uncle, just have fun.
